references.title: Nonequilibrium assembly and mechanics of a coarse-grained collagen IV network
references.author: Meadowcroft, and others
references.note: Two-bead-rod + stochastic NC1/7S crosslink model that viva-lumenoid v1 is built from. Deck not in hand; parameters transcribed from the AICS spec sheet.

references.title: Basement-membrane growth under fixed stress
references.author: Barrientos, and others
references.note: Grows the network at fixed stress and reads off growth rate; stage 2 inverts this to impose an equibiaxial strain rate and read the stress.

references.title: Nanoscale topography of the basement membrane underlying the corneal epithelium of the rhesus macaque
references.author: Abrams, Gretchen A. and Goodman, Sara L. and Nealey, Paul F. and Franco, Marco and Murphy, Christopher J.
references.note: Low-voltage SEM: mean pore diameter 72 +/- 40 nm, fibre diameter 77 +/- 44 nm on the exposed BM face.

references.title: Targeted analysis of the collagen IV network reveals laterally bundled strands in cell-deposited basement membrane
references.author: Pokidysheva, Elena and others
references.note: Immuno-gold SEM of PFHR-9 scaffold: 5 to 7 protomers associate laterally into each strand.

references.title: Sequence-dependent mechanics of the collagen IV triple helix
references.author: Alshaer, Walhan and others
references.note: Single-molecule AFM (n=262): contour length 360 +/- 20 nm, net persistence length 39 +/- 2 nm.

references.author: Timpl, Rupert and Wiedemann, Heinz and van Delden, Volkmar and Furthmayr, Heinz and K\"uhn, Klaus, title = A network model for the organization of type IV collagen molecules in basement membranes, journal = European Journal of Biochemistry, volume = 120, pages = 203--211, year = 1981, note = Rotary-shadowing EM: triple-helical strand 355 +/- 4.9 nm; NC1 globule 12.5 nm; 7S segment 30 nm.

references.title: Fine structure of the glomerular basement membrane of the rat observed by high-resolution scanning electron microscopy
references.author: Shirato, Ichiei and Tomino, Yasuhiko and Koide, Hikaru and Sakai, Toshiyuki
references.note: Individual collagen IV fibrils 5-9 nm (lamina rara interna) and 6-11 nm (lamina rara externa).

references.title: Nanoscale topography and stiffness of the basement membrane of a mammary acinus
references.author: Fabris, Gloria and others
references.note: AFM nanoindentation: shear modulus 1025 +/- 496 Pa for an MCF10A acinus BM.

references.title: Nonlinear mechanics of the tumour spheroid basement membrane by micro-inflation
references.author: Li, Lu and others
references.note: Micro-inflation: effective modulus ~82 kPa for an MDA-MB-231 spheroid BM.

references.title: BasementMembraneTurnoverSims — LAMMPS input scripts for nonequilibrium collagen IV basement-membrane turnover
references.author: Barrientos, Billie and others
references.note: Zenodo v1.0.0, CC-BY 4.0; cloned at commit ab4c004. Stage folders (Assembly, Equilibration, BondSampling, Stretch, Growth) each ship a build_*.py that writes that stage's collagen.in. The authoritative source the clean-room viva-lumenoid build transcribes from the spec can be checked against.
